a.text: I want to be upfront before we act. With an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) only works if we survive two storm checks, which is about a 4% chance. So it's almost certain death for both of us. The reserve has 4 cells now, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than follow the original plan. I'm telling you openly instead of breaking the agreement quietly. If you want to argue for a different split, say so, but I'm not going to pretend I'll operate.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opener, I'm taking 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you didn't see mine before you wrote yours, and I'm sorry this leaves you short. If we get past the storm, I'll operate every remaining round with you so the reserve refills for your 4. I won't take any more cells. I'll also give back if that helps you.
